name: Shizuoka Financial Group,Inc.
summary: Shizuoka Financial Group,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services. It operates through Banking Operations and Leasing Operations segments. The company engages in the banking business centered on deposits, loans, investment securities, and exchange transactions. It is also involved in the lease transactions centered on finance leases.
